# Security Package

This directory is the portable boundary for one evidence-driven security assessment package.

| Directory | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `cloud-scan/` | Exported Azure configuration and scan results |
| `background-docs/` | Correspondence, architecture context, and inherited information |
| `security-standards/` | Applicable controls, overlays, and security requirements |
| `standard-docs/` | Templates, evidence register, artifact index, and validation reports |
| `control-responses/` | One Markdown response per control, grouped by family |

Do not place credentials, tokens, passwords, private keys, or unredacted sensitive exports in this package.
